seriesTitle: High School Musical: The Musical: The Series

episodes.title: The Auditions
episodes.summary: A group of students at East High stages a performance of "High School Musical" for the winter theater production, only to realize that there is as much drama that happens offstage as there is onstage.

episodes.title: The Read-Through
episodes.summary: E.J. is jealous and reeling after losing the leading role of Troy to Ricky, and Miss Jenn tells the conflicted leading lady, Nini, to trust the process.

episodes.title: The Wonderstudies
episodes.summary: After 'losing' her phone and missing an important rehearsal, Nini suspects who is responsible for her bout with bad luck and surprisingly retaliates. EJ confronts Ricky about a heartfelt voicemail left for Nini. Meanwhile, Mr. Mazzara becomes suspicious of Miss Jenn's past.

episodes.title: Blocking
episodes.summary: After Nini discovers that E.J. isn't who she thinks he is, Ashlyn gets caught in the middle. Gina and E.J. team up as 'Wonderstudies,' and Ricky gets an unexpected visitor at home.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Miss Jenn organizes a girl's night out with Kourtney and Nini to help Nini shake off the boy drama, while the rest of the theater kids attend the East High Homecoming dance, where Carlos learns to dance like everyone's watching.

episodes.title: What Team?
episodes.summary: When Miss Jenn is placed on temporary leave and rehearsals are put on hold, the students rally together to defend their drama teacher.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: A rambunctious Thanksgiving "cast party" at Ashlyn's ends with surprising news for Gina, while Miss Jenn and Mr. Mazzara accidentally spend the holiday together at East High.

episodes.title: The Tech Rehearsal
episodes.summary: When the cast and crew unexpectedly need to find a new location to "tech" their production, Carlos secures a spooky theater downtown, forcing Miss Jenn to confront old demons.

episodes.title: Opening Night
episodes.summary: After months of rehearsals, the theater kids gear up for an unforgettable opening night. But when unexpected audience members show up to shake the cast to its core, will the show "go on" if the Wildcats aren't all in this together?

episodes.title: Act Two
episodes.summary: It's Act Two of opening night, and the stakes have never been higher. After last-minute cast changes in Act One — and so much left unsaid between Ricky and Nini — there's more drama offstage than on.

episodes.title: New Year's Eve
episodes.summary: Ricky, Nini, Gina, and the Wildcats gather at Ashlyn's for a New Year's Eve party. Miss Jenn runs into the new North High rival theatre teacher her ex-boyfriend - and at the stroke of midnight, shocking revelations come to the surface.

episodes.title: Typecasting
episodes.summary: Kourtney, Carlos and Big Red decide to join their friends and audition for on stage roles in "Beauty and the Beast," while Nini experiences FOMO from afar. When new competition shows up to the tryout, Gina tries to shake off some old habits.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.summary: Big Red and Ashlyn celebrate their first Valentine's Day together, amidst drama. Kourtney spars with a co-worker while Gina contends with being single. Meanwhile, Ricky and Nini's plans to surprise each other turn into a comedy of errors, leading to new revelations.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: When a blizzard barrels down on Salt Lake City, the Wildcats are stranded at East High after hours, just as E.J. receives some bad news. As cabin fever sets in, Miss Jenn inspires Nini to make a bold choice about her future; Kourtney's coworker Howie makes a surprising move; and Gina and Carlos come to blows.

episodes.title: The Quinceañero
episodes.summary: Gina and Seb rally the group to throw Carlos the music and dance-filled Quinceañero he never had. Meanwhile, Ricky accidentally oversteps in more ways than one, and Miss Jenn gets a wild idea about how to get Nini back onstage at East High.

episodes.title: Yes, And...
episodes.summary: After rival school North High releases a viral video to undermine the Wildcats, Miss Jenn hosts a weekend improv intensive to build up her kids' confidence. Meanwhile, Nini works on a new song at Salt Lake Slices, where she finds inspiration in Kourtney's approach to life.

episodes.title: The Field Trip
episodes.summary: When the Wildcats suspect that North High has stolen a key costume piece, they infiltrate their rival school and end up in a competitive dance-off. Miss Jenn goes face to face and toe to toe with Zack Roy. And an emboldened Nini takes a big risk.

episodes.title: Most Likely To
episodes.summary: When the Wildcats are benched from rehearsal for a week, tensions rise to the surface during Career Day. Big Red questions if Ashlyn understands his dreams; Howie makes a surprising move with Kourtney; E.J. shocks his dad with a revelation; and Ricky and Nini visit an old haunt.

episodes.title: Spring Break
episodes.summary: The Wildcats are on Spring Break, but they aren't taking a break from thinking about the musical. Nini is feeling the pressure to put out new songs for her music channel. Carlos is on a tropical vacation while Seb is back in the barn, feeling jealous. Ricky visits his mom in Chicago after not seeing her since opening night of "High School Musical." When Gina finds herself stranded at the airport, a surprise run-in changes her mind about what she wants.

episodes.title: The Transformation
episodes.summary: After rehearsals fall flat, the cast breaks into separate sleepovers to brainstorm Broadway-worthy ideas to outdo North High as the countdown to opening night looms. Secrets rise between Nini and Gina, and meanwhile Seb and Carlos suffer their first fight. Ricky receives an unexpected FaceTime call. Miss Jenn confides in Mr. Mazzara about her fear of losing the competition. The cast meets up at the stage unsupervised to rehearse the new plan.

episodes.title: Showtime
episodes.summary: "Be Our Guest" for the Wildcat's opening night, which wouldn't be complete without offstage drama.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.summary: The Wildcats opening night celebration is full of big decisions, revelations and second chances.

episodes.title: Happy Campers
episodes.summary: What time is it? Summer time! The Wildcats head west

episodes.title: Into the Unknown
episodes.summary: It's auditions... for the first time in forever! The campers meet the director and Nini looks ahead.

episodes.title: The Woman in the Woods
episodes.summary: The Wildcats embark on a camping trip where friendships form and illuminating discoveries are made.

episodes.title: No Drama
episodes.summary: Corbin Bleu is back! The cast is shook when a camper disappears and a shocking letter arrives.

episodes.title: The Real Campers of Shallow Lake
episodes.summary: Carlos stirs up drama to save the docu-series, but will it be to the detriment of the production?

episodes.title: Color War
episodes.summary: When the campers partake in an epic sports competition, summer-long tensions rise to the surface.

episodes.title: Camp Prom
episodes.summary: A throwback 70s themed prom unexpectedly inspires everyone to look to the future.

episodes.title: Let It Go
episodes.summary: Nerves run high on the opening night of "Frozen," as the documentary's release quickly approaches.

episodes.title: High School Musical 4
episodes.summary: Disney announces that "High School Musical 4: High School Reunion" will be shooting at East High.

episodes.title: HSM v. HSM
episodes.summary: The Wildcats contend with "High School Musical 3" auditions *and* "High School Musical 4" rehearsal.

episodes.title: A Star Is Reborn
episodes.summary: High School Musical 4 pulls focus from "High School Musical 3" for a Wildcat star-is-born moment.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.summary: At Gina's Halloween party, relationships are put to the test and secrets are revealed.

episodes.title: Admissions
episodes.summary: With Ricky and Kourtney off to college and the other Wildcats distracted, the musical is in peril.

episodes.title: Trust the Process
episodes.summary: The Wildcats revisit the past in order to secure the future of the theater program.

episodes.title: The Night of Nights
episodes.summary: Ricky, Gina, and the rest of the Wildcats must make big decisions on opening night of HSM 3.

episodes.title: Born to Be Brave
episodes.summary: Act Two of HSM 3 Opening Night is shaken up by surprise guests and looming decisions.
